# Test Article

This is a test article to verify that the data branch can trigger a deployment.

## What this tests

1. GitHub Actions trigger from data branch push
2. Checkout master source code
3. Copy data files from data branch
4. Build and deploy to GitHub Pages

If you can see this, the pipeline is working correctly!
